node.statement: Invoke lem-stage1-polar-retraction and denote its universal constants by P and q. Replacing only q by min(q,1/64) preserves every conclusion because the new smallness hypothesis is stronger; take C_pol=P and C_grp=600. These are universal, C_pol,C_grp>=1, and 0<kappa_pol=min(q,1/64)<=1/2.
